figures.finding: Since 2026 Surinamese screenwriters, directors and producers may apply to the Netherlands Film Fund's Studio Caribe short-film programme: of 14 projects selected for development, 7 get a production grant, one of them from Suriname.

value.fund: Studio Caribe (Netherlands Film Fund), second round

sources.said: Starting from March 1st, filmmakers from from Aruba, Bonaire, Curaçao, Saba, Sint Eustatius, Sint Maarten and Suriname can apply for the second round of Studio Caribe. … From all applications, 14 projects will be selected for th … In the next year, 7 of these projects will then be selected for a production grant — 6 from the islands and 1 from Suriname.
